info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Hotel Loyalty Points Rules-v4-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Rules API provides access to the list of rules governing hotel loyalty points accumulation and redemption. This endpoint allows consumers, such as hotel partners and developers, to retrieve detailed information about the various loyalty rules applicable to members. With this data, businesses can enhance their customer engagement strategies and ensure compliance with loyalty program guidelines. This API is essential for integrating loyalty point systems and optimizing reward offerings.

get.summary: Retrieve the list of points rules.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current rules related to points, including how points are earned, spent, and any applicable conditions. It is essential for understanding the points system.

requestBody.description: This request body expects a JSON representation of the required parameters for retrieving the rules related to points. Ensure that all necessary data conforms to the defined schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the rules for points.
